hooks.text: 每次回家之旅都会重排异世界顺序、能力供给和升级选择，形成数百万种组合
hooks.excerpt: This procedural sequence of worlds, offerings of abilities, and upgrades, yields a highly replayable roguelike sequence which ensures that every session is completely unique. There are millions of possibilities. Committing to decisions and improvising an effective build is core to the game.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 合作能力可重定向友方攻击、放大队友法术，并协调眩晕与增益产生真实联动
hooks.excerpt: Redirect friendly attacks, amplify each other's spells, coordinate stuns and buffs, and much more. In The Black Pool, co-op play is more than simply playing the game together— you are rewarded for actually working together to be successful.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每次尝试都会解锁跨局永久强化，既提高基础实力也开放新的玩法路线
hooks.excerpt: In addition, you unlock permanent enhancements that persist across playthrough attempts which make you stronger, and also enable varied play styles.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
